items.html: And in the explanation of this language I was in doubt as to what I heard from my master, of blessed memory: for first it said "He was adorned," and afterward it said "He brought out flaming lights from Him," meaning that after Atik was corrected through the clothing of his seven lower [Sefirot] in AA, then He brought out these nine flaming lights from Him, for through the aforementioned Atik He brought out the aforementioned lights, which are the Sefira of Keter of Atzilut, called AA, which divides into nine lights alone. And these nine Sefirot of AA are the nine lights that are not spirits, as mentioned in the aforementioned places.
